mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above $700 billion signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700 billion.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS increase > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4%, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST YoY < -10% and UNRATE > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 5% YoY and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a strong supply-side expansion with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO YoY > 5% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.
